## 2026-04-23 - Developer UX via OpenAPI Metadata
**Learning:** For backend-only FastAPI services, UX improvements can successfully be framed as Developer Experience (DX) enhancements by adding semantic summaries, descriptions, and parameter hints directly into route decorators.
**Action:** When a repository lacks frontend components, evaluate its auto-generated interactive documentation (like Swagger UI) as the primary user interface and enrich it with explanatory metadata.
